name: shift-card
blurb: Card that expands and shifts content sections on hover or touch.
description: A card with separate top/middle/bottom content areas. ShiftCardContent animates height and opacity on hover, revealing hidden content. Supports mouse and touch interactions.
use_when: Interactive cards where progressive reveal of content (price, details, CTA) guides user attention through hover.
avoid_when: Touch-only layouts where persistent expand state could trap content off-screen or conflict with scrolling.
a11y: Content is revealed on hover but remains in document flow. Focus management depends on implementation. Keyboard nav requires manual testing.
